notes.title: PUZZLE KINGS CHALLENGE - HOT New Feature Now LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]HUGE new update to TetraLogical![/h1]

LOTS of work done, including the following!

[h3]The biggest by far, is the HOT new "[b]PUZZLE KINGS CHALLENGE[/b]" mode![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/00c2b4b9465e1a1e4fb627ac5caeb871f2446b2b.png[/img]


You'll notice a new "[b]PUZZLE KINGS CHALLENGE[/b]" button on the left of the screen, and this will be enabled and select-able once the entire GLOBAL and FRIENDS Leaderboards for ALL levels, from Steam have been synchronised (just takes a couple of seconds generally!).

The new [b]CHALLENGES INFO[/b] panel beneath this new button will show any [b]CROWNS LOST, HELD[/b], or [b]WON / GAINED[/b], once synchronised!  (These will be counted and tallied up for the current session, UNLESS you switch from FRIENDS to GLOBAL at any point, as this simply resets the WON / LOST' since last shown, notification!)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/846d329430641971852fe04ee0d0ec6c6a6113f8.png[/img]



For example, if you were [b]KING [/b]on any Puzzle Level, and have been beaten on it since last played, the game will let you know [b]WHO [/b]beat you, and what their best time is.  :D   ....You can then jump into THIS easy-to-use new [b]CHALLENGES [/b]screen to directly play levels, if you want to try and regain your crowns!  :) ([i]NOTE - You can also use CURSOR LEFT / RIGHT / UP and DOWN, etc to quickly move through levels![/i]):-


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/2c2992c64307b92caf060517512973f79aceffe3.png[/img]


[u][b][h1]Other stuff!:-[/h1][/b][/u]

In addition to this, I've also worked on some other improvements, just because I could add them...   :D

[b][list]
[*] Enhancement to PUZZLE MODE! (REQUESTED) - You now get a very helpful, highly visual indicator of where your piece is currently classed as EXACTLY over, on the current game board.

[*] Enhancements to NONE-PUZZLE modes! - I've now added a nice new 'Shockwave' effect to more easily highlight where your top scoring move was - it's not essential, and can be turned off in the SETTINGS MENU if preferred (or if it runs slow on an old system), but I liked it!  ;)

[*] Enhancement to ALL Modes! - Some GREAT tweaks to timings, to make the game more fluid / enjoyable - plays really smoothly now, turns are MUCH faster, and (for now), the computer 'OPTIMISING PIECES' process is GREATLY sped up!  [i](NOTE - I may have to move to a newer build of the engine at some point soon for online multi-player, which seems to be a bit slower for my AI optimisations, so this *may* possibly return to somewhere near it's original speed again in the future - fingers crossed it doesn't!)

[*] Fixed a silly sound bug, where sometimes sounds weren't played, whoops![/i]
[/list][/b]


[h3][i][b]As always, HAVE FUN and a HUGE thank you for your support, guys! - Please let me know what you think of the new mode and improvements - I've worked really hard on them, and it would be awesome (and motivational!) to get some feedback or even reviews!  ;)
[/b][/i][/h3]

Den / Japster

notes.title: Small-ish, but nice update!
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]A small-ish update![/b][/u][/h1]

[b]By request! - I've added a new Windowed mode resolution options and movement control!
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/0427dece468b7ce6f801f8612e40dd3cebdd784b.png[/img]


[i]1) You can now switch between Full Screen and Windowed modes that are smaller than the Windows resolution.  You'll now see an extra area in the Settings Menu, giving a choice of Window sizes to run TetraLogical in, for when you are NOT running in Full Screen - You can select any size offered, and de-selecting Full Screen will run the game in a window of that size - it's dynamically selectable without having to restart...  :)

2) I've also added a 'ghosted' title bar window dragging control (which becomes visible when hovered over, at the very top of the window!), so if you are in Windowed mode, you can click, hold and drag the TetraLogical game window around to wherever you'd prefer it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/8f7ef72f858d18b69e2b22948f101fbbe3666699.png[/img]

3) Also added a couple of fixes to my new levels - whoops! - I'd not checked they were fully Puzzle Mode solvable - they are now!  :)

4) Sounds and music volume levels saving, and music staying OFF if you selected NO music volume, are also fixed.[/i]


As always, have fun, and thanks for the support guys!   :D

notes.title: UPDATE Released - Cloud Saves, New Levels and more!
notes.content:
*NEW!* - A brand new updated release for all of my TetraLogical fans! - Grab it now! - it's got:-
[i][b][olist]
[*] CLOUD SAVES - TetraLogical now saves to the CLOUD also! - ALL progress, plus your current progress / saves states for ALL Puzzle Mode levels...   Fire up TetraLogical from any of your Steam Client PC's - Desktop / Gaming PC / Laptop etc, and play where you left off!  :D

[*] NEW LEVELS! - 12 additional levels have been added, ALL Puzzle Mode compatible too! - Have fun beating them / setting your best solved time!

[*] Some small but helpful bug fixes - Including a couple of corrected level names, some text positioning (Level Editor Screen, and "Optimising Pieces" now display correctly again! - ...and another where previews were causing problems.  If anybody was affected by that last one, I'd be grateful to know if it's now resolved!
[/olist][/b][/i]
As always, have fun!

Many thanks for the support,

Den / Japster

notes.title: Update Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/222a0c95be588d27ec4445c02a89b33e148668b2.png[/img]

[u][b][h1]*NEW* build now LIVE, with enhancements and a couple of fixes!
[/h1][/b][/u]

[b]FULL list of changes - many thanks to Marco, for most of these suggestions!:-
[/b]

1) GREAT new feature for PUZZLE MODE! - Now, hovering over a level in Puzzle Mode will show you who (globally!) has the best time to beat, and what time to beat! - Here's hoping it motivates some of you to attack each other's best times!   ;)

2) Puzzle Mode - Same easily-identifiable noise when placing pieces as normal mode.

3) Puzzle Mode - NO delay between tiles destroyed animation and giving a new piece.  Makes the game more fluid, and potentially faster to complete levels, based on skill! - Go for it!

4) Changed "Scroll" references to "Mouse Wheel" throughout game - makes more sense!...

5) Puzzle Mode Level Previews - new feature:- Hovering over these will now get the best time and player! - You'll know what (and who!) to beat...

6) Hopefully fixed an a small bug where if the game is optimising puzzle pieces in Puzzle Mode, and you impatiently Exit / Retry, you could leave it stuck it on an 'optimising' cursor.

7) Re-jigged some of the ludicrously difficult levels, and placed them in the 'Crazy' levels pack...
  
8) Enhancement to the editor, easier to use! - Added more controls to now 'shift' a layout around, adding or deleting columns or rows from ANY edge of the layout (Top, Bottom, Left, Right) - it makes creating levels a LOT more fun/easier, for example, if you need to adjust WHERE your cool graphics are in the level, or find that you need another column or two to the LEFT or TOP, you can now do this!

9) Additional controls for the control method, to also allow the popular group 'A' and 'D' keys to rotate your piece!

Thanks again for your support, everyone!  :D

Enjoy!


[b]PS - The next interim update will also show you your best, and the best score to beat, in the Puzzle Mode screen itself.  I'll also be letting you know if anyone has beaten you since you last played, if you had the TOP TIME on a Puzzle Level, but have since been beaten - you can then decide if you want to go and take your crown back, there and then!  :D[/b]

notes.title: New In-Game Achievements Summary Screen!
notes.content:
[h1]IN-GAME ACHIEVEMENTS ARE NOW AVAILABLE[/h1]

[i][b]...I've added a fancy screen to tot up and show, inside the game, how you're doing with regards to completing the game's many achievements!...  :)[/b][/i]

[i](EDIT:- Players NO LONGER need to edit any STEAM settings to see these! - they should just work and display fine for everyone!)[/i]

If STEAM has successfully loaded, then STEAM will send the current player's achievements data to my game and the [u][b]TROPHY ROOM[/b][/u] button will be active, and press-able once the game has synchronised achievements data (generally takes just a couple of seconds!):-

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/b143e72e82c337890e54dd9e8527c78d25ce3794.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/b6290a71cb4a3559c5e9d2d5e1c140219ef717d7.png[/img]

[b]Simply use the [b]UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT[/b] Cursor keys, OR [b]Left-Click the mouse[/b] anywhere in the Achievements window or drag up or down, to scroll faster or slower....  :)[/b]

You can then browse your achievements in-game, to easily see which ones you're missing, or have been awarded (I'll also add stats soon, so you can see how close you are to getting stats-based achievements (ie. Beat the Master AI 10 times etc)).

[b][i]NOTE - The Achievements Screen will dynamically update, as soon as you earn any achievements in that session! - So hopping back into the Trophy Room after beating an achievement WILL show it as earned, instantly...  :)[/i][/b]

Oh, and I also added some nice graphical background effects, and started work on CLOUD DATA SAVING too, ready for the next update!...  :)

[i][u]Let me know what you think, and thanks again for your support![/u][/i]

[i]PS - STATS-based achievements aren't updated dynamically *yet* - So don't worry, if you get a stats-based achievement (ie. Beat the Master AI 'X' times, etc) and it doesn't yet show in Trophy Room - it will show when the game is next started...  ;)[/i]

Den / Japster.

notes.title: Just to let you all know that I'm now working on the ONLINE MULTI-PLAYER!
notes.content:
[b][h1]ONLINE (STEAM) MULTIPLAYER![/h1][/b]

Just a quick announcement to say that after a while adding all of the other features and promised (and then some!) modes, we're now tackling adding the promised ONLINE MULTIPLAYER functionality for TetraLogical!

It's a *BIG* update in terms of work required, as we're having to re-write the turns logic, game logic, achievements recognition, etc to also work with remote players, but it's moving along smoothly, albeit slowly (to get it right and not break anything - LOTS of testing to do too!), at present!

[i](BTW - We know that some people are managing to play the game in valve's GREAT new couch sharing multiplayer mode, and fair play to them! - but that relies on a great connection, plus,  all players control the mouse in this mode, hence it's a little awkward to play, so adding dedicated online lobby based matchmaking and multiplayer should make for the best experience we can give!...)[/i]


[h1][b]MAC OS and LINUX releases imminent![/b][/h1]

In other news, we've squashed the last couple of bugs that occurred in the MAC OS and LINUX beta builds, so [i][b]TETRALOGICAL [/b][/i]will shortly be available on those platforms too!!


[i][b]Thanks as always for the support, everyone! - I don't know about you guys, but I'm raring to kick some of my online friends' butts on the game! (or more likely, have mine kicked by them! ;) )[/b][/i]

Cheers,


[b]Japster[/b]

notes.title: TETRALOGICAL's Workshop / User-Created Levels Submission area is now LIVE!!!
notes.content:
[h1]The NEW User-Created Levels Submission is NOW included inside TetraLogical![/h1]

[i][b]If you fancy creating any levels for submission in TetraLogical's updates, then you can now simply click the new UPLOAD button found in the Level Editor![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/e7c20a632557d1fc41ef25b3b3b1c5b16c572867.jpg[/img]

[b]Once successfully uploaded, you should hear a confirmation sound (and will be adding confirmation prompts to the game in the next update), and your new level should appear on Steam's Workshop area in a matter of minutes, for other players to vote on for inclusion in the regular (and of course, FREE) levels updates for [i]TetraLogical![/i][/b]

Other than that, have fun guys!

notes.title: New DELETE USER LEVEL button, and a couple of new levels / Puzzles!
notes.content:
Well, I've been steadily beavering away on the latest (admittedly small but useful!) update to the game for the last few days, and I've now got the logic in for user levels deletion / maintenance!

There's now a new [u][i][b]DELETE LEVEL icon[/b][/i][/u] in the EDITOR screen, which will become active/bright red if on a USER created level.

I've also added a whole lot more functionality behind the scenes, to make adding levels even easier, including auto-sorting of the levels displayed, cleaning up of files for deleted levels, and lots more!

I've tested it in pretty much every scenario, and I'm satisfied that it definitely keeps user levels and data safe, while removing all redundant files to ensure no issues occur with old level data, saves, previews etc...

NOTE:- As this DELETE button will INSTANTLY delete a user created level, I want you to be SURE you meant to do it!... :D

...hence, a simple mouse click will *NOT* delete the current level. For your certainty, you have to press and HOLD down the RIGHT mouse button, and while holding that, click the LEFT mouse button on the DELETE button. You will hear a nudge sound if you didn't do this properly, and a different sound if you did!... :)

[i][u][b]Give it a try! - the update is out NOW![/b][/u][/i]

Oh yeah, I also added a couple of new levels / PUZZLE MODE layouts, Levels 105 and 106 - they're seasonal ones, if a little early!... ;)

[h1][i][u][b]NEXT UP! - Level sharing functionality![/b][/u][/i][/h1]

...it may not be the most straightforward compared to Steam workshop, but I think I have a way of saving a level (or levels) out, which you can then send/share amongst friends! - The game can then simply import them in, if it finds any new levels in your game install folder, and add them automatically!...

notes.content:

Thanks for the support all, it means a LOT to me....  :D

Den / Japster

notes.title: PUZZLE MODE SAVE STATES ARE NOW *LIVE*! - Have fun!
notes.content:
[b][h1]I've now implemented PUZZLE MODE PROGRESS SAVING![/h1][/b]
...complete with a message on the level previews to show those levels with games in progress/saved, if TetraLogical finds a save state for the previewed level and difficulty settings! (ie. Puzzle Mode, Hard, Level 14, etc)

So, NOW, if you've placed at least ONE piece and started your game, then the QUIT button will become a [u][b]SAVE AND EXIT[/b][/u] button, and you'll find that exiting from an unfinished puzzle game by either pressing this button, or by clicking the CLOSE icon at the top right of the screen, will now create a save state/snapshot for it.  Going back in to try any SAVED puzzle again will automatically reload it at the exact point where you left it!

ie. If you only have 5-10 minutes to play, you can still have a blast at progressing a particular level, then whenever you play a move, it will update the save state, ready to continue next time, if you have to exit the game.

If you want to take time to try and fully solve the CRAZY or HARD levels, for example, you can now take ALL the time you like, WHENEVER you like, figuring out the best moves, chipping away without needing to set aside a huge chunk of time to think about completing a tough puzzle in one go!

[h1][b]Enjoy the new SAVE functionality, guys![/b][/h1]

PS - Pressing the RETRY button will CLEAR and restart the current level, and can still be pressed if you've broken your current attempt, to quickly start another fresh attempt... :)      (PS - If you choose RETRY, and simply exit without playing any pieces, then NO save state will be saved.  Good for clearing any 'game in progress' markers for levels that you've started by mistake... :)  )

notes.title: PUZZLE MODE Automated SAVE/CONTINUE almost ready for release!...
notes.content:
Ultimately, ALL play modes will feature automated progress saving for the current level, mode, and game settings, ...but, I had a few days spare before I take a break with my family, so....

[h1][b]...[/b]I[i][b]'ve nearly implemented PUZZLE MODE PROGRESS SAVING![/b][/i][/h1]

...complete with icons on the level previews to show those levels with games in progress/saved, if TetraLogical finds a save state for the previewed level and difficulty settings!   (ie. Puzzle Mode, Hard, Level 14, etc)

So, when the update is released (hopefully tomorrow!) you'll find that exiting from an unfinished puzzle game will now create a save state/snapshot for it, then going back in to try that puzzle again will automatically reload it at the exact point where you left it!

ie. If you only have 5-10 minutes to play, you can still have a blast at progressing a particular level, then whenever you play a move, it will update the save state, ready to continue next time, if you have to exit the game.

If you want to take time to try and fully solve the CRAZY or HARD levels, for example, you can now take ALL the time you like, WHENEVER you like, figuring out the best moves, chipping away without needing to set aside a huge chunk of time to think about completing a tough puzzle in one go!

Enjoy guys! - Like I say, hopefully have it ready for release tomorrow!

[h1]PS - Pressing the REPLAY button (which will be renamed to RETRY) still simply restarts the current level, and can still be pressed if you've broken your current attempt, to quickly start another fresh attempt...  :)[/h1]

notes.title: FINALLY! - Update released! - Go grab it!
notes.content:
[b][h1]ENHANCED HELP IN PUZZLE MODE is now *LIVE*!![/h1][/b]

In SOLO PUZZLE MODE, The CPU will now attempt to help you with the best pieces, from up to 40 tiles (up to 10 moves) away from a solution!

If you reach 7 moves and haven't broken the current puzzle, then you're pretty much assured of getting the correct 7 pieces to finish the puzzle, although WHERE to place them may not be readily apparent!

Try it and let me know what you think, guys! - I think it makes PUZZLE MODE a LOT fairer, and more enjoyable as a result!


[h1][b]ADDED A BRAND NEW AUDIO TRACK![/b][/h1]

SKAVEN has very kindly allowed me to include one of his latest, SUPERB audio tracks in the latest update, and it's a cracker - you can now choose "[i][u][b]GAMMA KATANA[/b][/u][/i]" from the jukebox, and I'm loving it!

As always, if you love TETRALOGICAL's music, please feel free to visit SKAVEN's Soundcloud and check out his other fantastic FREE music at https://soundcloud.com/skaven252


[h1][b]IN-GAME HELP PAGES updated![/b][/h1]

Worth a quick read, as some more info and help is in there! 


[h1][i][b]PS - The NEXT UPDATE (In 2-3 weeks max) will include PER-LEVEL SAVE GAMES, USER LEVEL DELETION option and some other level editor enhancements, and any other stuff I can fit in!

The next one after that should bring in-game Leaderboard browsing, achievements obtained info, and some other enhancements![/b][/i][/h1]

notes.title: Overdue update!
notes.content:
[b]Hi All! - Hope you're enjoying TetraLogical![/b]

Just a quick update to say that whilst I've been slowly (very slowly! :( ) implementing this new pieces logic, I've also been adding other requested features...

So, once I get this trickier update out with better end game puzzle mode pieces help, you will shortly afterwards have:-


[h1]1) PER LEVEL SAVE STATES / SNAPSHOTS!:-[/h1]

Simply, on EVERY level, if you exit your game, it will SAVE (or update) your progress on that level - effectively letting you tackle ANY level when you have a few minutes to chip away at it! - Like some of the larger challenges!

Note:- The save game format and SAVING logic is pretty much sorted, I just need to restore saved games and set up the game to continue from it, which I'm currently working on.

Using this, you will be able to resume ANY game type, for ANY level, at any point! (Solo, Vs, Standard, Blitz, Puzzle, etc!).

[b]Of course, continuing a BLITZ mode game will mean that it's difficult to immediately jump back in and get your head around where you left it, so the game will give you a couple of seconds' pause before restarting the BLITZ countdown timer![/b]


[h1]2) USER CREATED LEVEL DELETION:-[/h1]

User level deletion, via a simple button on the LEVEL EDITOR screen.  Simply navigate to a level that you don't want any more, then once on-screen, click the DELETE / TRASH button (this will of course only show for USER CREATED levels!).  You'll then get a chance to cancel, and clicking YES will completely delete that level.


ONLINE MULTIPLAYER is of course also on the cards still, I just have to get the basics out of the way first, and once I DO get this in, you can be sure to find me looking for some competition! - I've no doubt that some of you more experienced TetraLogical players will soundly beat me at my own game, so to speak!   ;)


[i][b]Anyway, that was it everyone! - I just needed to touch base and give you all an update, to let you know that an update is imminent, although it's taken longer than I'd hoped due to the complexity of changing the pieces allocation logic, and because of day job weekend IT projects I had to help with...  :([/b][/i]

notes.title: Better help for Puzzle Mode endgame, plus some other fixes, almost ready for release!
notes.content:
[h1]More help in PUZZLE MODE!:-[/h1]

We've REALLY optimised the CPU help for the endgame in Puzzle Mode! - The computer will now do it's best to help allocate the best mix of pieces for up to 28 free Tile Slots / SEVEN possible pieces away from the end of a Puzzle completion attempt!...  :)


[h1]ANIMATED CURSOR / 'THINKING...' INDICATOR[/h1]

As it's thinking harder, although it's generally pretty fast (less than 1/4 of a second to 1/2 second, to work those out), due to the random nature of shape placements and calculations for each scenario / board state, it can sometimes take a bit longer - so we've now added a 'BUSY' cursor and message (instead of freezing the cursor!), for those times when it's taking a little longer (generally a second or two, but can possibly be up to 4 or 5 seconds absolute max on rare occasions). 

Note that while it's calculating the best pieces for you, your GAME CLOCK will be frozen, indicated by turning RED.  ie. Your game completion time/speed will NOT be affected if it takes a little longer to help you out! :)


[h1]Bugs and Enhancements!:-[/h1]

[list][*] Added more relevant End Game messages for PUZZLE MODE End Game!:-     "SOLVED!" and "UNLUCKY!"...
[*] Fixed a silly bug on the PUZZLE MODE Percentage Scoring! - Now correct!
[*] Added an easier to read splash screen...  :)
[*] Some other little bug fixes and tweaks that I managed to do, along the way!
[/list]

notes.title: I didn't want to post 2 announcements so close to each other, but I'm really pleased!!
notes.content:
...as I realised that there was a whole bunch of SOLO gaming effort from players going unrewarded, so I've now added:-


[h1]SOLO NORMAL PLAY LEADERBOARDS! (1000+ of them!)[/h1]

[b]So[/b], we now have [i][b]10 Leaderboards, for EACH built-in level[/b][/i] (currently 104), for [i][b]ALL [/b][/i]ranking Efficiency ratings...

If you finish a SOLO RELAXED or TIMED MOVES game, and get any of the following Efficiency rankings - 75%, 80%, 85%, 90%, 95%, 96%, 97%, 98%, 99% or a [i][u][b]PERFECT 100%[/b][/u][/i], you'll rank on the relevant Leaderboard for the current level!

Have fun, and let's see some scores set for myself and Lorna to beat!  :D


[h1]NEXT UP!!![/h1]

I'll be adding an ACHIEVEMENTS GALLERY, to view in-game, and more importantly (as there are so many of them!), an in-game LEADERBOARDS browser, for any UNLOCKED levels, for the current game mode!!

So, once added, if you're looking to play, for example, a bit of BLITZ, just select that mode, navigate the Levels Selection, and (if you're logged in to Steam) RIGHT-CLICK on a level to bring up ALL of the relevant Leaderboards for that level!

The same goes for the other modes, nice 'n' easy! - a LOT easier than trying to navigate them with no organisation to them, to check yours and others' scores, using Steam's pages...  ;)

I may also be changing the End Game Leaderboards display to display ALL relevant Leaderboards per level / mode, so even if you didn't rank in one of them, you can still browse them at the end of your game, to see what scores you need to get, to beat players' rankings!

[b][h1]
As always, have fun![/h1][/b]

notes.title: Quick update guys! - More Levels, RELEASE status, etc!
notes.content:
[h1]MORE NEW LEVELS![/h1]

Just a quick update! - Firstly, I've just added another bunch of levels to keep you busy guys! - along with some more Leaderboards to attack!

You now have [i][b]104 [/b][/i]levels built-in, to play while I code some more stuff into TetraLogical!

Now that I'm happy with the levels count for now, I'll be looking to add more computer help to Puzzle Mode next, to aid in not getting problem pieces before you hit the magic 20 tiles left number...  :)

[h1]Puzzle Mode is IN![/h1]

[/b]

To celebrate this milestone, I've also temporarily discounted [i][u][b]TETRALOGICAL [/b][/u][/i] (Discount should be live on the 7th June, and will run for TEN days!) to hopefully increase the community size, maybe get some wishlisters on board, more reviews etc, and start making the Leaderboards busier, to celebrate finally getting this implemented (it's been a tough cookie to crack for the endgame logic!) 

The computer 'help' as regards allocated pieces is also in, albeit with a couple of player-friendly tweaks still needed to make piece allocation a bit better BEFORE you hit 20 tiles... (at present, this is the point where the computer WILL lend a hand and give you the best fitting pieces, albeit in a random order, so you still need to think on how to play them in order to still solve the puzzle!), so you may possibly get a puzzle-breaker piece before then, if you've not played in such a way to get rid of these possible pieces, by leaving 'slots' for them somewhere in the board!)

If we get more players, and more reviews, then Valve/Steam will also let me add the other MEANINGFUL achievements I wanted to add, but can't as I've virtually run out (only 100 allowed, while Steam is 'learning' about my game, and that won't change without more reviews and players playing it for longer than an hour total!)

Again, I stress it's an early (but still fun!) preview, but still missing an additional helpful tweak I'm intending implementing, so can still force you to lose the level by giving you a none-optimal piece, if you don't plan your moves to maximise your options, piece-wise, until you hit 20 tiles!

[h1]I'd give you some hints and tips to maximise your chances of beating levels, but a lot of the fun comes from figuring out what to do, and what NOT to do, in terms of leaving yourself with options / where to attack the board, etc![/h1]


[h1]What's new in this release?:-[/h1]

[list]
[*] PUZZLE MODE! - Also shows you your time taken to solve a puzzle, purely for information at present, but can be ignored and played relaxed.

[*] 68 levels now included for NORMAL, BLITZ and LIMITED MOVES modes!

[*] Around 50 of these levels are ALSO available in the new PUZZLE MODE, categorised by difficulty, or size/craziness!

[*] 4 more colours to play with in the Level Editor / Creator (with more on the way), as I needed some extra shades of blue and red for some level ideas to work!
[/list]

[i]PS - It's less levels than the total, simply because you cannot solve a level if the tiles aren't divisible by 4, so some levels simply cannot be played in Puzzle Mode without affecting the way they look just for the sake of making them compatible with Puzzle Mode!   :)[/i]

PPS - Unlike normal mode, in PUZZLE MODE all levels are playable to try and beat at ANY time, and are split into 4 difficulties (either by complexity, or for CRAZY levels, by size!).  Beating these levels by solving them completely WILL mark them as UNLOCKED/BEATEN within the main modes ALSO, but you'll still be unable to play them in those modes until you beat enough preceding levels beforehand!  ;)


[h1]What's currently NOT in this release? (but generally imminent!):-
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Possibly extra logic to help your chances of NOT getting a duff piece in the bit [i]just [/i]before the endgame (ie. around 24-32 pieces left on the board), if user preference is to have this added (as opposed to a one-use per game 'swap' button).

[*] LEADERBOARD ENTRIES for PUZZLE MODE Levels Completion (Fully Solved + Fastest Times).

[*] ACHIEVEMENTS for solving puzzles!

[*] Possible one-time option during the course of a game, to swap ONE piece for a different piece, either in EASY mode, or just there regardless.

[*] The ability to play your OWN creations in Puzzle Mode (requires splicing index files, and comprehensive checks for Puzzle Mode completability, which I need to add!)

[*] Online Multiplayer - it's DEFINITELY going to be added, just needs time (a lot of time!) spent on it, and developing it...
[/list]


[h1]I'd like to also take the opportunity at this point to thank my loyal supporters and players, you've been an amazing help and morale boost, and I really hope that you like the new mode so far! - Please, please continue to tell your friends about my game, if you feel they'd also enjoy it!
[/h1]

notes.title: Puzzle Mode is nearly ready!
notes.content:
This was tougher to implement than I thought! - But, it's now looking like a week or two of work before it's ready (time permitting!), to create leaderboards, modify the level selection to ONLY show puzzle-mode enabled levels, give a relevant endgame summary screen, etc...

It plays well so far, although of course, even with the correctly assigned pieces near the end of your game, it's still possible that you can have already rendered the board uncompletable with an earlier move, so in this mode it's VERY important to take your time and play strategically, carefully studying the board when placing new pieces, to avoid breaking it, etc!

I've also added those additional colours (both for my own levels, and in the Level Creator/Editor!), and re-worked some of the existing levels to be completable in Puzzle Mode, plus some other tweaks and fixes!


[h1]Some PUZZLE MODE tips!:-[/h1]

I'd advise always doing your best to leave yourself somewhere to place a problem piece type that you may get, without causing 'islands' of empty slots that do NOT divide perfectly by 4 (tiles per shape).

PLUS, on tight sections of a level, try to picture if a piece that you're about to place might render other slots unplayable! (ie. if only a LONG piece will fit inside a closed space, try to picture which other pieces need to 'butt up' against it to solve that section without rendering other slots unplayable), then try to keep those slots free for the correct piece, etc...

Once you're down to five last possible moves / 20 free slots left, the computer will step in and try to dynamically allocate the best mix of pieces (not just ones that will fit for the current turn, but more ones that will fit the MOST pieces into how final free slots) to allow you to have a better chance of completing the puzzle, but of course, HOW you place those pieces plays a big part in that...  ;)

Of course, there will be some instances where you are unfortunately given a none-optimal piece before this point (for example, if you've created a very tight, scattered play board), but you can either retry the level, or if you're playing on an easier difficulty setting, you will have access to a limited number of 'SWAP's to request another (always different shape, if it's possible) piece....  :)

NOTE! - SWAPPING will penalise you time-wise, and will not count as a 'flawless' puzzle completion!

...ie. You will 'beat' the level, and unlock more levels, but will NOT gain an online ranking - so if you have to use it extensively, you'll probably have to kiss that Leaderboard 'Fast Completion' ranking chance, and flawless puzzle completion achievement, goodbye!


[h1]So, in short - Thanks for your patience, and my apologies that it's taking a bit longer, but please bear with me! - PS - I'll upload some screenshots tonight, to whet your appetite...   :D[/h1]

notes.title: New LIMITED MOVES Game Mode now LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]TetraLogical's 'LIMITED MOVES' Game Mode is now LIVE!![/b][/u][/h1]

Give it a try! - You can choose from a starting 'pot' of 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 80 or 100 moves/turns....

As usual, the aim is to get the best Score and Efficiency percentage that you can, in your allocated moves, BUT, as per BLITZ mode, skillful playing will net you MORE turns....

[h1][b][list]
[*] If you get 48 in a single move, you'll earn 5 more turns.

[*] If you get 47 in a single move, you'll earn 2 more turns (Essentially a FREE TURN (see below) for that move played, plus a bonus turn).

[*] If you get the BEST move possible, but it isn't a 47 or a 48, you'll essentially get a FREE TURN, and your moves pot will remain the same / NOT use up that turn.
[/list]
[/b][/h1]

Use this to your advantage! - try to keep earning more turns by getting the best scoring move as often as you can, to prolong your game....  :)

Of course, the dilemma of this mode is that you may see a nice 47 or 48 on the board, but do you play possibly lesser efficiency moves and wait for the right shape to get it for extra moves, or just play the best scoring moves you can? - Early on in a game, you may be trying for 100% (so not advisable generally), but if it happens later, at say 93% efficiency, it might just be worth it for those 5 extra moves!...   decisions....   ;)  

[b][i]Along with the new game mode, there are an additional 216 Leaderboards added! (1 for each of 3 level size categories, for each of these, 1 for each STARTING MOVES selection, and for each of those, 1 each for the best scores for 75%+, 80%+, 85%+, 90%+, 95%+, 96%+, 97%+, 98%+, 99%+, and of course, [b][i][u]NO 100%![/u][/i][/b] (taken this logic out, as yes, you would theoretically be playing forever if you could achieve this!))[/i][/b]

[h1][u][b]LEVEL SIZE TIERS:-[/b][/u][/h1]
[b][h1][list]
[*] 50 or less tiles      = SMALL
[*] 51-100 tiles          = MEDIUM
[*] 101 or more tiles  = LARGE
[/list][/h1][/b]

[h1][u][i][b]Additionally...[/b][/i][/u][/h1]

As usual, during testing, I've set a few scores, and you may be happy to know that a few more leaderboards will be created to record your best runs for any given starting BLITZ or LIMITED MOVES game!

ie. If you last for say, 1:35 in a 1 Minute Blitz game, you'll be submitted to that Leaderboard! Same for the other time selections, 2 minutes, 5 minutes, etc...

...and for Limited Moves mode, the same will happen, but for the highest ACTUAL MOVES played in a game, versus the initial limitation of 10,20, 50, etc...

Should be fun seeing some of these set!

PS - I may well re-use the Blitz bar to visually show your moves left in this mode, but as this is a more relaxed mode and not timed/under pressure, I think that the large Moves Counter does the trick! - Of course, always happy to get feedback either way!  :)

PPS - I also added a nice summary to the End Game screen in BLITZ and LIMITED MOVES/TURNS modes - Will now tell you how long you [b]actually [/b]lasted in your timed BLITZ game (compared to the starting time that you were given, or how many turns you actually managed to play compared to your starting pot for TURNS mode) ready for the above enhancements and Achievements (2 For 1, 3 For 1, Logic Machine, etc)...  :)

I've also added 3 new Achievements specifically for this - ie. if you manage to last/play for DOUBLE, TRIPLE, or QUINTUPLE the starting MOVES or TIME in either BLITZ or LIMITED moves, you will beat those Achievements... :)


[h1][u][b]BUG FIXES:-[/b][/u][/h1]

Of course, I've also added new tweaks and bug fixes to the game, including the following:-

1) Now, exiting out of the EDITOR won't throw you into the LEVEL SELECTION screen to start a game (might have seemed intentional, but it wasn't!  ;)   )...   It will now take you back to the Main Menu itself, as makes more sense...

2) Tweaked the end game timings - was way too much of a delay between Game Over, and actually showing the endgame screen and/or Leaderboards summary.   Changed timings a bit to speed it all up, and changed the logic to smoothly wait for the update, then display.

3) Other little bits and pieces in general, that I spotted while adding all of that above!


[u][h1][b]...and don't forget, the recent and addictive BLITZ mode is also available, and we should be seeing more scores appearing on those Leaderboards soon, so let's get competitive!!  ;)[/b][/h1][/u]


[h1][i][b]Thanks as always for the support guys, and please, if you're loving the game, spread the word, or perhaps maybe leave a short review/rating! - It's currently my single biggest way of hopefully getting more exposure....   :D
[/b][/i][/h1]

Den / Japster

notes.title: BLITZ mode is now LIVE!!! - It's a blast! - Have fun everyone!!!
notes.content:
** 'BLITZ' GAME MODE RULES **

You start with the selected time on the clock, and for visual ease, you'll simply see a larger time meter at the bottom of the screen.

Take turns as usual, aiming to get the highest score you can, for the EFFICIENCY rating that you finish on, by your last move...   (so, if you've got 100% efficiency by the end of the game, ie. a chance to be immortalised on the 100% efficiency BLITZ Leaderboard for the current level, do you score extra points and risk knocking it down to 99%, 98% etc (ie. a lower efficiency ranking leaderboard, or take what you've got? - decisions!)

THE DIFFERENCE is that once played, all unsupported tiles will fall down, and new tiles will appear on the board to re-fill it! - This means that you have to be alert for possible higher scoring moves after every turn!

Scores for given EFFICIENCY percentages ARE counted, no matter what, BUT...

**************************************************************
...LEVELS can now also be unlocked by getting at LEAST 90% efficiency in BLITZ mode!!!

NOTE! - There is ONE condition....    ....Levels are ONLY unlocked / beaten, if you've played at least an average of 10 moves per minute on the game mode (ie. 50 moves in a 5 minute BLITZ game), to avoid players cheating to perform easy unlocks!   Heh heh...    ;)

*************************************************************

Also....

You're not limited to the time that you select!:-

    - If you score 48 in a single move, you'll be granted an additional +15 seconds on the clock!

    - If you score 47 in a single move, you'll be granted an additional +8 seconds on the clock!

    - If you get 46 or less, BUT get the TOP score for your move, you'll earn +5 seconds on the clock.

NOTE:- The TIMER BAR will STORE / COUNT excess time, even if the tube is currently maxed out! - so eg:- if you score additional time bonuses from the start, it *WILL* count - you'll see that the timer bar stays topped up until the time left is less than it holds (ie. 1 min, 2, mins, 5 mins, etc)

Have fun, and let's see some high scores people!


PLEASE NOTE - Due to MANUALLY having to create EVERY single description for the 100's leaderboards before they're recognised (ARRRRGH!) I've had to add for BLITZ mode (50 levels at present, 8 or so Efficiency ratings, and 8 different TIME settings for Blitz!), at present BLITZ mode works GREAT, but the Leaderboards aren't all live...    The first 5 levels are completely done and LIVE to set about beating scores on!...  ...Currently working on the rest!

notes.title: Okay guys! - Just released an updated build, with a sneak peek at some new game modes, and new menus!
notes.content:
[h1]So.....   ....Firstly....[/h1]

We now have a much easier to navigate menu system to use!

Also, coming out of your game will land you back exactly where you were, in the menu system!

So if playing Vs, selecting a level, and playing, then exiting will bring you right back to the Vs. Level Selection screen, and the same if playing Solo...  :)

Also, moving backwards and forwards takes you back a menu level instead of right back to the main menu...  :)

Anyway! - Some other stuff added, like nice helpful navigation aids / headings, improved look and feel, and of course...    (as I've started coding them in....  :)   ):-

NEW game modes teaser!  (NOTE! - You can PREVIEW these modes in the menu, but you CANNOT play them yet - Once you've taken a look and hopefully got the gist of the new modes that are incoming, you'll have to select good old STANDARD mode again, with or without time limits per moves, and play that for now, in Solo or Vs.)...  )

So.....   ....I have (coming soon!):-


[h1][i][u][b]BLITZ MODE![/b][/u]
[/i][/h1]

This is basically a set amount of time on the clock that runs down until depleted (at which point it's Game Over), and you have to score the highest in that amount of time!

To save running out of moves, EVERY move is followed by a DOWNFALL, and new blocks replace used blocks, from the top.

I'm toying with the idea of adding precious seconds to the clock for 100% efficiency moves, at least for the first half of the board...  :)


[h1][i][u][b]LIMITED MOVES MODE![/b][/u]
[/i][/h1]

This is basically a set amount of MOVES/TURNS to get the highest score in, and you have to score the highest in that amount of moves!

Again, to save running out of moves, EVERY move MAY be followed by a DOWNFALL (ie.  it may be that I just perform a downfall and refresh only once the board is exhausted, or after every move), and new blocks will replace used blocks, from the top.

Again, I'm toying with the idea of adding precious seconds to the clock for 100% efficiency moves, at least for the first half of the board...  :)


[h1][i][u][b]PUZZLE / CLEARANCE MODE![/b][/u]
[/i][/h1]

The point of this game mode is simply to CLEAR as much of (and if possibly, ALL of!) the current PUZZLE board.

This mode will also include a separate level editor mode, to ensure that levels created CAN be completed....

Of course, SCORE and EFFICIENCY/IQ percentage are not relevant to this mode, so the only things recognised and scored on, are whether you actually manage to CLEAR the level, or if not, how many tiles you have left when the board is exhausted / no pieces of ANY type, can be placed.

Of course, as quick-thinking is harder to do without mistakes on this type of challenge, it's only fair that the best times for each PUZZLE level, for both CLEARED, and say 1,2,3,4, or 5 pieces remaining, will be uploaded to the relevant leaderboard too! - More fame and bragging rights!!!   :D

As the pieces are given you in random order, it takes some careful placing and analysis/forward thinking, to ensure that you don't leave those 'islands' of tiles, that are NOT divisible by 4 tiles...    therein lies the challenge on some of the tougher layouts!


[h1][b]That's it for this announcement! - Please, PLEASE spread the word or support my Early Access release, and make [i][u][b]TetraLogical[/b][/u][/i] the success that it deserves to be once complete! (in my humble opinion...  ;)  )  :D[/b][/h1]

In addition to this, the game now saves and updates a global Leaderboard with your TOTAL *perfect* 100% Efficiency played games, AND your best streak of them (and of course, resets the counter if you fluff one...)

PS - It ONLY counts (and resets!) your 100% streak (and only counts 100% Perfect games) if you are playing in either SOLO, or 1 Player Vs. any CPU at present... ie. so you're safe playing with your mates, or any combination of at least 2-3 CPU's, or 1-vs-1 when NOT playing the Master AI... 　

BTW - The reason I can't count more than 1 or 2 player games, is of course, that it's FAR easier to get 100% Efficiency if you're playing far less moves in a game, ie. against more players...
